title: VideoTrail: Interactive Video Foraging Through Hierarchical Visualization
abstract: arXiv:2611.25377v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: People often watch videos to find information, but locating relevant moments can be difficult and time-consuming. Existing strategies like scrubbing rely primarily on visual scanning and linear search, providing limited support for goal-directed navigation. We present VideoTrail, an AI-powered browser extension that supports information seeking in videos through a hierarchical visualization. Inspired by information foraging theory, VideoTrail surfaces semantic and structural cues as information scent, creating an explorable roadmap of segments. The system is multimodal and adaptive, prioritizing visual or textual scent based on the video's content. In a user study (N=16), VideoTrail helped participants efficiently locate key moments and enabled new navigation strategies compared to traditional timelines, highlighting how exposing an adaptive video structure can enhance goal-directed viewing.

translated_title: VideoTrail：通过层次化可视化实现交互式视频信息觅食
translated_abstract: 人们常常通过观看视频来查找信息，但定位相关片段可能既困难又耗时。现有的策略（如拖动进度条快进浏览）主要依赖视觉扫描和线性搜索，对目标导向式导航的支持有限。我们提出了VideoTrail，这是一个AI驱动的浏览器扩展，通过层次化可视化支持视频中的信息搜寻。受信息觅食理论的启发，VideoTrail将语义和结构线索呈现为“信息气味”，构建出一个可探索的视频片段路线图。该系统是多模态且自适应的，会根据视频内容优先呈现视觉或文本线索。在一项用户研究（N=16）中，VideoTrail帮助参与者高效地定位关键时刻，并且相比传统时间线实现了新的导航策略，凸显了揭示自适应视频结构如何能够增强目标导向式的观看体验。
tldr: VideoTrail是一个基于信息觅食理论的AI浏览器扩展，通过多模态自适应的层次化可视化将视频中的语义与结构线索呈现为“信息气味”，帮助用户高效定位关键时刻并支持目标导向的视频信息搜寻。
en_tdlr: VideoTrail is an AI-powered browser extension inspired by information foraging theory, which leverages hierarchical, multimodal, and adaptive visualization to surface semantic and structural cues as information scent, enabling users to efficiently locate key moments and support goal-directed video information seeking.
